test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In March 2025, NITI Aayog released the 'Trade Watch – Quarterly (July-September [Q2] FY25)' report. According to this report, which of the following commodities entered India's top ten imports due to rising infrastructure demand?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Copper**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the NITI Aayog's 'Trade Watch – Quarterly (July-September [Q2] FY25)' report, **copper entered India’s top ten imports** due to increased infrastructure demand.
 
• Copper is widely used in **construction, electrical wiring, and industrial applications**, making it critical for infrastructure projects.
 
• The global demand for copper has surged due to its use in **renewable energy systems**, such as solar panels and wind turbines, aligning with India's green energy goals.
 
• India's domestic copper production has declined in recent years, prompting higher imports to meet **growing infrastructure needs**.
 
• The report highlights that **India's focus on urbanization and industrial expansion** has contributed to the increased demand for copper imports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Copper and Infrastructure Development**

 
 
• Copper is a **highly conductive metal** used extensively in electrical systems, including power transmission and distribution.
 
• It is a preferred material for **plumbing, roofing, and cladding** in construction projects.
 
• The rising demand for energy-efficient solutions has further increased copper usage in **electric vehicles (EVs) and renewable energy projects**.
 
 
 
• **India's Copper Industry**
 
 
• India has witnessed a decline in domestic copper production since the closure of Sterlite Copper's smelter in 2018, leading to increased reliance on imports.
 
• Major copper-consuming industries in India include **power, construction, and transportation**.
 
• India imports copper from countries like **Chile, Japan, and China** to meet domestic requirements.
 
 
 
• **Global Copper Demand Trends**
 
 
• The global push towards **decarbonization and renewable energy** has significantly increased copper demand.
 
• Electric vehicles use approximately **four times more copper** than traditional vehicles, further driving demand.
 
• Copper is essential for developing **smart grids** and advanced infrastructure systems worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Trade and Economic Implications**
 
 
• Increased imports of copper may widen India’s **trade deficit** in the short term.
 
• Strategic investments in domestic copper production and recycling could reduce dependency on imports.
 
• The rise in infrastructure projects is expected to **boost economic growth** despite higher import costs.
